summary: Six original recognisable salvage drop pickups, including thin corrugated offcuts with revised irregular corrosion/dull zinc, and construction-specific wear across the shared salvage atlas. Editable Blender source, 18 LOD meshes, six convex envelopes, three 2K runtime PBR sets (sheet colour source 1254px), 12 transparent engine-rendered icons, standalone C# Godot inspection scene and measured QA.

coordinate_conventions: Metres; Blender Z-up converted by glTF exporter to Godot Y-up; ground-centred pivots, no held-item socket contract.
known_issues: Standalone asset delivery; main-game integration and coordinator art acceptance remain pending.
Convex pickup envelopes intentionally fill openings and empty assembly space.
No unique bake UV channel or high-to-low bake is supplied; UV0 uses documented metric/trim reuse.
Distant LODs are visibly coarse when enlarged; switches are at 6/16m, cull at 45m.
Procedural trim/rope and generated-source sheet material supplied for review; no AAA approval or photogrammetry claim.
CorrugatedSteel colour source is native 1254px, resampled to 2048 runtime; no additional source colour detail is claimed.
game-dev CLI unavailable locally; independent binary/engine/package audits are supplied instead of a registry receipt.
next_reviewer_action: Inspect the revised sheet metal and the six engine/LOD/icon views, then review the catalogue/material remaps before integration. No AAA approval is claimed.
